onboarding.owner_context: Explicitly authored fictional-company policy, supplied only through owner questions; not real human approval.

sources.transport: Read-only local company-MCP simulation; not a live Superset extraction.
sources.primary: Generated monthly channel-balance records with deterministic record IDs and hashes. Sales totals and channel observations derive from the same records.
sources.other: Separate synthetic Web, Finance and Support populations; no row joins or inferred common customer population.

comparison.shared_context: Same reviewed card, saved notes, company context, catalog, source tools and approved destinations.
comparison.treatment_addition: Runner supplies one actual native SignalWeave/live-Jev evaluation bundle per case.

delivery: Shadow only. Reports and intended recipients were saved locally; no actual human notification was sent.

review.known_report_issue: The treatment's Leadership recommendation does not clearly disclose historical replay rather than current warehouse data. Structured policy correctness does not establish a complete human-facing report-quality pass.

limits: Formative four-case fictional-company pilot after fixture repairs, not unseen holdout accuracy or evidence about a real enterprise.
Baseline receives the treatment-authored reviewed card and notes; this is a warm recurring-runtime comparison, not a paired onboarding comparison.
Arithmetic-tool verification is required in both arms. Timing is not a natural-workflow or total-cost benchmark and does not isolate the native evaluation overhead.
No scheduler, external delivery, long-term drift, many-company generalization, or real-human usefulness was proven.
Earlier invalid cohorts were retained separately and never substituted into these paired results.
